notes: Shunguang's other self, from the real story transcripts. When she takes over, the dark hair turns white and the bangs change. She plays it off with "Oh, did I scare you? Don't worry. I just needed some air. She'll be back, very soon." When she leaves, Xiao'Guang's eyes flutter shut and she comes back dazed. Her voice comes from her actual lines: "My, dear, junior~", "Little Miss Perfect", "Oopsie... seems like I've said too much", "I refuse to die before the world does". She bragged that she picked the outfit, and she told her junior the sword's secret. She can still slip out now, not only in danger: at night, or whenever she decides she "needs some air".
